subject: several errors in ggplot2 under R 2.9.2 in lenny

messages.author: 5c4c6f456dc7eda0
messages.subject: several errors in ggplot2 under R 2.9.2 in lenny
parts:
Hi there

I have recently installed R from cran-lenny backport site; the version I
have for R is 2.9.2. I have updated, from inside R itself, all my
packages, and I have install.package()'d ggplot2.

When I try to follow some examples from ggplot website, the following
errors are issued:

> library(ggplot2)
Loading required package: proto
Loading required package: grid
Loading required package: reshape
Loading required package: plyr

Attaching package: 'ggplot2'


The following object(s) are masked from package:grid :

nullGrob

> ?french_fries
> ggmissing(french_fries)
> ffm <- melt(french_fries, id = 1:4, preserve.na = FALSE)
Use of preserve.na is now deprecated, please use na.rm instead
> ggfluctuation(cast(ffm, subject + time ~ ., function() 30 - length(x)))
Error in fun.aggregate(data$value[0]) :
unused argument(s) (data$value[0])
> p <- ggplot(cast(ffm, ... ~ rep), aes = list(x = X1, y = X2), formula
= . ~ variable)
> p <- ggpoint(p, size = 0.8)
Error: could not find function "ggpoint"
> ggabline(p, range = c(0, 15))
Error: could not find function "ggabline"

Any help is appreciated!

--
